alignments.note: כִּי rendered by the causal connective *Seeing*.
Existential יֵשׁ takes the presentative frame *there are*, headed on the word carrying the predication rather than on the supplied dummy (rule 50's reasoning).
דְּבָרִים → *things*. The margin's *Or, words* was read and set aside under rule 38.
Articleless participle recast as a relative clause keeps the supplied relative with the attributive itself (rule 41), headed on the lexical verb.

יֹתֵר rendered by the predicate expression *the better*, which takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20); the unit is discontinuous around *man* under rule 25 and heads on the word carrying the lexeme.
The ASV's recasting leaves the preposition with no English word: *man* stands as a bare subject and the copula belongs to the predicate (rule 40).
The assimilated article is a real token (rule 12); no *the* is written before *man*.

review_notes: Every source and target ID is partitioned exactly once.

The copula was given to the predicate יֹתֵר rather than to the preposition, since the ASV writes no English preposition at all here; giving *is* to the לְ as rule 49's prepositional predicate was the competing reading, but it would leave that preposition holding a word for a relation the English never states.
